“daSAhaM prAhuraSOcaM sapiRqezu vipaScitaH । mftezu cATa jAtezu brAhmaRAnAM dvijottamAH ॥ nityAni cEva karmmARi kAmyAni ca viSezataH । na kuryyAdvihitaM kiYcit svADyAyaM manasApi ca SucInaniDanAMstvanyAn SAlAgnO hAvayeddvijAn SuzkAMnnena PalErvvApi vEtAnAjuhuyAttataH ॥ * ॥ na spfSeyurimAnanye na ca teByaH samAharet । caturTe paYcame vAhni saMsparSaH kaTito buDEH ॥ sUtake tu sapiRqAnAM saMsparSo na praduzyati । sUtakaM sUtikAYcEva varjjayitvA nfRAM punaH ॥ daSAhaM nirguRe proktamaSOcaM cAtinirguRe । ekadvitriguREryuktaM catustryekadinEH SuciH ॥ daSAhAttu paraM samyagaDIyIta juhoti ca । caturTe tasya saMsparSaM manuH prAha prajApatiH ॥ * ॥ kriyAhInasya mUrKasya mahArogiRa eva ca । yaTezwAcaraRasyAhurmmaraRAntamaSOcakam ॥ * ॥ trirAtraM daSarAtraM vA brAhmaRAnAntu SAvakam । prAk saMskArAt trirAtraM syAdasmAdUrdDaM daSAhakam ॥ UnadvivArzike prete mAtApitrostadizyate । trirAtreRa Sucistvanyo yadi hyatyantanirguRaH ॥ AdantajAtamaraRe pitrorekAhamizyate । jAtadante trirAtraM syAdyadi syAtAntu nirguRO ॥ AdantajananAt sadya AcUqAdekarAtrakam । trirAtramOpanayanAt sapiRqAnAmudAhftam ॥ jAtamAtrasya bAlasya yadi syAnmaraRaM pituH । sadyaHSOcaM sapiRqAnAM karttavyaM sodarasya ca ॥ UrdDvaM daSAhAdekAhaM sodaro yadi nirguRaH । aTordDaM dantajananAt sapiRqAnAmaSOcakam ॥ ekAhaM nirguRAnAntu cUqAdUrdDaM trirAtrakam । adantajAtamaraRaM samBavedyadi sattamAH ॥ ekarAtraM sapiRqAnAM yadi te'tyantanirguRAH । vratAdeSAt sapiRqAnAmarvvAk snAnaM viDIyate । sarvvezAmeva guRinAmUrdDvantu vizamaM punaH ॥ * ॥ arvvAk zaRmAsataH strIRAM yadi syAdgarBasaMsravaH । tadA mAsasamEstAsAmaSOcaM divasEH smftam ॥ ataUrdDvantu patane strIRAM syAddaSarAtrakam । sadyaHSOcaM sapiRqAnAM garBasrAvAcca vA tataH ॥ garBacyutAvahorAtraM sapiRqe'tyantanirguRe । yaTezwAcaraRe jYAtO trirAtramiti niScayaH ॥ * ॥ yadi syAt sUtake sUtirmmaraRe vA mftirBavet । SezeREva BavecCudDirahaHSeze trirAtrakam । maraRotpattiyoge tu maraRAcCudDirizyate ॥ aGavfdDimadASOcamUrdDaYcettena SuDyati । aTa cet paYcamIM rAtrimatItya parato Bavet । aGavfdDimadASOcaM tadA pUrvveRa SuDyati ॥ * ॥ deSAntaragataM SrutvA sUtakaM SAvameva tu । tAvadaprayato martyo yAvacCezaH samApyate ॥ * ॥ atIte mftake proktaM sapiRqAnAM trirAtrakam । taTEva maraRe snAnamUrdDvaM saMvatsarAdyadi ॥ vedArTavidaDIyAno yo'gnimAn vfttikarzitaH । sadyaHSOcaM Bavettasya sarvvAvasTAsu sarvvadA ॥ strIRAmasaMskftAnAntu pradAnAt parataH sadA । sapiRqAnAM trirAtraM syAt saMskArAdBarttureva ca ॥ atastaddattakanyAnAmaSIcaM maraRe smftam । UnadvivarzAnmaraRe sadyaHSOcamudAhftam ॥ AdantAt sodare sadya AcOqAdekarAtrakam । ApradAnAt trirAtraM syAddaSarAtramataH param ॥ mAtAmahAnAM maraRe trirAtraM syAdaSOcaka m । ekodakAnAM maraRe sUtake cEtadeva hi । pakziRI yonisambanDe bAnDavezu taTEva ca ॥ ekarAtraM samuddizwaM gurO sabrahmacAriRAm । prete rAjani sajyotiryasya syAdvizaye sTitiH ॥ gfhe mftAsu dattAsu kanyakAsu tryahaM pituH । parapUrvvAsu BAryyAsu puttrezu kftakezu ca ॥ trirAtraM syAttaTAcAryye svaBAryyAsvanyagAsu ca ॥ AcAryyaputtre patnyASca ahorAtramudAhftam ॥ ekAhaM syAdupADyAye svagrAme Srotriye'pi ca । trirAtramasapiRqezu svagfhe saMsTitezu ca ॥ ekAhaM vA SvaSuryye syAdekarAtraYca Sizyake । trirAtraM SvaSrUmaraRe SvaSure cEtadeva hi ॥ sadyaHSOcaH samuddizwaM sagotre saMsTite sati ॥ * ॥ SuDyedvipro daSAhena dvAdaSAhena BUmipaH । vESyaH paYcadaSAhena SUdro mAsena SuDyati ॥ * ॥ kzattraviwSUdradAyAdA ye syurviprasya bAnDavAH । tezAmaSOce viprasya daSAhAcCudDirizyate ॥ rAjanyavESyAvapyevaM hInavarRAsu yonizu । svameva SOcaM kuryyAtAM viSudDyarTaM na saMSayaH ॥ sarvvetUttamavarRAnAM SOcaM kuryyuratandritAH । udvarRaviDidfzwena svantu SOcaM svayonizu ॥ zaqrAtraM vA trirAtraM syAdekarAtraM krameRa tu । vESyakzattriyaviprARAM SUdre zvASOcameva tu ॥ ardDamAso'Ta zaqrAtraM trirAtraM dvijapuNgavAH । SUdrakzattriyaviprARAM vESyezvASOcamizyate ॥ zaq rAtraM dvAdaSAhaYca viprARAM vESyaSUdrayoH । aSOcaM kzattriye proktaM krameRa dvijapuNgava ॥ SUdraviwkzattriyARAntu brAhmaRe saMsTite sati । daSarAtreRa SudDiH syAdityAha kamalodBavaH ॥ * ॥ asapiRqaM dvijaM pretaM vipro nirhftya banDuvat । aSitvA ca sahozitvA daSarAtreRa SuDyati ॥ yadyannamatti tezAntu trirAtreRa tataH SuciH । anadannannamahnE va na ca tasmin gfhe vasan ॥ sodarezvetadeva syAnmAturAptezu banDuzu । daSAhena SavasparSe sapiRqaScEva SuDyati ॥ zaqrAtreRATavA sarvve trirAtreRATavA punaH । anATaYcEva nirhftya brAhmaRaM Danavarjjitam ॥ snAtvA saMprASya tu GftaM SuDyanti vrAhmaRAdayaH । avaraScedvaraM varRamavaraM vA varo yadi ॥ aSOce saMspfSet snehAttadASOcena SuDyati ॥ * ॥ pretIBUtaM dvijaM vipro yo'nugacCati kAmataH । snAtvA sacelaM spfzwvAgniM GftaM prASya viSuDyati ॥ ekAhAt kzattriye SudDirvESyAnAM syAt dvyahena tu । SUdre dinatrayaM proktaM prARAyAmaSataM punaH ॥ * ॥ anasTisaYcite SUdre rOti cedbrAhmaRaH svakaH । trirAtraM syAdaTASOcamekAhaM tvanyaTA smftam ॥ asTisaYcayanAdarvvAgekAhaM veSyaSUdrayoH । anyaTA cEva sajyotirbrAhmaRe
